note_en: 既…也… means "both… and…" for two qualities or roles: 包粽子对很多人来说既是一种传统手艺，也是一家人一起动手、增进感情的活动 "for many people, wrapping zongzi is both a traditional craft and an activity that brings the family together." 既 and 也 each go before a verb (here 是), so 是 is repeated, unlike English, where "is" appears only once.
